title: Remote MCP, HTTP, CLI and Client Access Skill
scope_completed: implemented the seven frozen Remote MCP tools with the official low-level MCP SDK, strict request and response validation, stateless JSON Streamable HTTP sessions, bounded worker offload, and lossless ApplicationPortError envelopes

implemented the shared FastAPI application with MCP mounting, liveness and sanitized readiness, Attachment prepare and streaming PUT, and Artifact streaming download through only the frozen Application and Query Ports

adopted the exact r3 method-qualified Port error closures, including Query VALIDATION_ERROR and both state-read errors, while preserving STATE_CORRUPT and STATE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED as HTTP 503, CLI 3, and nonretryable

accepted durable r3 post-commit success with case_view null across MCP, HTTP prepare, HTTP PUT, and the client workflow, using BusinessReceipt identity for the PUT success projection without inventing current Case state

forwarded the raw validated PUT Content-Type as UploadAttachmentContent.expected_content_type, forwarded strict non-negative declared_size values for S03 business classification, and rejected unsafe or Content-Type-mismatched archive names before Port calls
implemented cancellation-safe upload and Artifact streaming bridges that abort request sources, settle worker threads, and close normal, late, failed, and cancelled BinaryStream results
implemented immutable environment settings, dotenv process-environment precedence, single-worker CLI hooks, canonical validate-state output, and atomic no-authority export-state behavior
implemented and validated the problem-locator-client Skill and helper workflow plus S00-Port-conforming application, query, state, stream, MCP, curl, ID, and fault-injection test doubles

risks: The approved S06 dependencies remain absent from the frozen root lock because this slice cannot modify root dependency files; S08 must integrate one compatible shared set before composition.

Real S02-S05 service implementations and process-level startup remain uncomposed in this slice; S08 must run the required shared-instance, restart, upload-adoption, readiness, and no-leak integration seams.
integration_notes: The isolated acceptance environment used mcp 1.29.0, FastAPI 0.139.2, Uvicorn 0.49.0, python-dotenv 1.2.2, httpx 0.28.1, and Starlette 1.3.1; no root dependency or lock file was changed.
CCR-S06-001 and CCR-S06-002 remain resolved by v1-contract-r2 through the unique ApplicationPortError channel and UploadAttachmentContent.expected_content_type; r3 introduced no new S06 contract gap.

The r3 implementation consumes nullable post-commit CaseView semantics, exact method-qualified Port error sets, strict Query raw-input validation, and canonical archive filename suffix rules without adding private fields, errors, caches, or bypass protocols.
Normal JobControl claim competition and asset failure receipts remain outside S06; no production interface path contains special CLAIM_REJECTED logic.

PrepareAttachment declared_size is strict non-negative at the interface and values above 2684354560 are deliberately forwarded to S03 for RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED classification; actual PUT expected_size remains frozen at the Attachment limit.

This clean rebuild starts directly from v1-contract-freeze-3 at 99279d082938dce2a0cdd65f99835cf69571ae84; its implementation tree is byte-for-byte and mode-for-mode equivalent to archived implementation 56212be19de502cec3907c951edaaeed65cda5d3, which was used only as a tree/blob source and is not in this branch's ancestry.

S08 should use composition_hooks to inject one shared ApplicationCommandPort, ApplicationQueryPort, StateAdminPort, IdGenerator, and public base URL into the MCP and HTTP app, and should wire the root problem_locator __main__ entrypoint owned by S08.
The Skill layout and metadata were maintained and validated with the repository-external skill-creator tooling; only the S06-owned .claude skill directory was written.
